title: isolation-probes
description: What the live isolation probes of this machine found (<state>/orch/isolation-probes.json, written by scripts/isolation-probe.py --live, read by policies/isolation.py): per provider and CLI version, whether each probed surface was loaded. A surface with false is confirmed off for that version and may raise the guarantee of its profile to full.

probes.description: One entry per provider and CLI version, the latest probe of each.

claims.description: Surface -> whether the probe found it loaded (true) or not (false).
